description:
Perform a sensitivity analysis on the loaded CT Cranium dataset by exporting three 3D surface models of the skull at different Hounsfield Unit (HU) thresholds. You must create three separate segmentation masks (or modify one sequentially) and export a binary STL for each. 

1. Threshold min: 200 HU -> Export to /home/ga/Documents/skull_200HU.stl
2. Threshold min: 400 HU -> Export to /home/ga/Documents/skull_400HU.stl
3. Threshold min: 600 HU -> Export to /home/ga/Documents/skull_600HU.stl

Keep the maximum threshold at 3071 HU for all masks. Ensure all files are saved in binary STL format.
